"World Barometer" is a web app indicating the current air pressure, temperature and humidity wherever you are. Allow geolocation, and the app will show the local weather data. Click to adjust the brass pointer, click and hold (long click) to relocate and remeasure. Search to get weather data for any location in the world.

https://www.thomasweibel.ch/world-barometer/
